result.description:
The RUBIMIX-8 N is a high-performance 1400W electric mixer designed specifically for the tiling professional. Engineered for versatility, it effortlessly handles a wide range of materials, from viscous cementitious adhesives and resins to paints and mortars. Its lightweight construction is paired with a double-grip ergonomic handle, ensuring maximum comfort and reduced fatigue during extended use.

This mixer features an electronic speed regulator, allowing you to fine-tune the 0–750 RPM range to achieve a perfectly homogeneous mix every time. Whether you are mixing large batches of grout or heavy-duty adhesive, the RUBIMIX-8 N provides the reliability and precision required on a busy job site.

  • High-Torque 1400W Motor: Delivers consistent power for mixing heavy, viscous materials like tile adhesive, grout, and resin.
  • Variable Speed Control: Features an electronic regulator (0-750 RPM) to optimize the mixing speed for different materials, preventing splashes and ensuring a smooth consistency.
  • Ergonomic Double Grip: Designed with bi-material handles for improved comfort and stability, offering better control during high-torque mixing.
  • Safety First: Includes a safety lock switch on the handle to prevent accidental start-ups and corner protectors to shield the tool from impact on-site.
  • Universal Compatibility: Equipped with a standard M14 thread connection, making it compatible with a wide range of mixing paddles. It can also be adapted for non-threaded rods or the FAST-IN system (sold separately).
  • Ready to Work: Comes complete with a 120mm removable mixing paddle, ideal for mixing up to 25kg of mortar or adhesive right out of the box.
  • Professional Durability: Built with lightweight, high-resistance materials and backed by a 2-year warranty (plus extra points for Rubi Club members).

result.name: Hemsworth™ Beige Tile
result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Its rectangular design makes it easy to recreate a traditional flagstone floor, giving you a contemporary country aesthetic. The matt tiles have high slip resistance and can be used on the walls, floors and fitted outdoors.

media.alt_text: Victorian Flooring™ Plain Black Square Tile.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Suitability

Due to its delicate metallic finish, we do not recommend the use of Rhomba Metallic in a shower or any area where there is an increased risk of acidic or alkaline substances coming into contact with the tile surface.

Tile Care & Maintenance

Due to its delicate metallic finish, it is important that only pH neutral cleaners are used when cleaning Rhomba Metallic. Any acidic or alkaline based cleaners can damage the tiles surface and therefore should be avoided when cleaning.

Initial Clean: Dilute Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:20 with clean water and apply the solution across the surface, working on small areas at a time. Leave the solution to react for a few minutes and clean well using a suitable pad or cloth. Remove any residues using a clean cloth and rinse well with clean water.

Routine Maintenance: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (approximately 3 capfuls with 5L of water) and clean the surface using a suitable cloth, rinsing the cloth regularly with clean water. Leave the surface to dry. There is no need to rinse.

result.name: Regal® Ash Movement Joint 12.5mm

meta.description: Regal Ash Movement Joint 12.5mm
meta.title: Regal Ash Movement Joint 12.5mm | Topps Tiles

result.description:
• 10mm width and various depths hard wearing aluminium movement joint matched to the Regal Collection range of tiles and grout.
  • These aluminium profiles absorb heavy stresses and evenly distribute them throughout the flooring and foundations. 
  • The epoxy-compound infill absorbs up to 20% across the width of the joint, e.g. 2mm is absorbed across a 10mm wide infill. 
  • The metal profile makes them ideal for heavy footfall areas.
  • When using them on floors where there is a joint in the sub-floor or a structural movement joint, they MUST be followed through into the tiled surface. 
  • They can also be used on suspended floors, directly over the junction of two substrates (e.g. screed to timber) or where the tiling area exceeds 10x10m (with no one side exceeding 10m in length).
  • On heated floors, they should be used where the tiling area exceeds 40m², with no side exceeding 8m in length. 
  • Select the profile to suit the thickness of the tiles being used.
  • During installation, apply the tile adhesive around the junction using a trowel, then press the profile into the adhesive and align it to the tiles.
  • Spread tile adhesive over the entire surface of the joint and fit the tiles into the adhesive, aligning them so they are flush with the top edge of the profile.
  • Allow a joint of 2mm around the profile and fill it with grout. 
  • Length: 2.5m.
  • Other depths are available.

result.name: Victorian Flooring™ Darlington™ Black/White Tile
result.tile_care:
BAL Protective Sealer MUST be used when grouting with dark pigmented grouts. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see the grout manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue
This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Slight staining to the surface of the tiles can be removed using BAL Microshield Plus and abrasive pad.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and wash using a cloth or large brush and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.
Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Restoring the original flooring found in a Victorian property can be difficult, often the floor has been cracked with time or damaged from adhesives used to lay other flooring over the top from past eras. Coming across the original flooring to find replacements is also a costly venture, not only to source but to get fitted too.

Our Victorian Flooring range has been specifically designed to replicate the traditional tile designs from the Victorian era but with a contemporary twist to keep your space feeling fresh and modern. Its innovative mesh backing means easy and accurate installation every time, saving both time and money compared to individual tile installation.

The Newbury range is made up of a series of octagons and diamonds, although this pattern predates the Victorian era it was synonymous with the typical Victorian home. The range of colours make this a versatile option depending on your style. The white completes a traditional aesthetic, the black creates drama in a more colourful home and the burnt terracotta lends itself well to a more rustic or country inspired scheme.

Each mosaic sheet features a predetermined grout width ensuring accuracy throughout, and the meshed back allows for multiple cuts to be achieved at a time. All our Victorian Flooring™ mosaics work perfectly with both the Diamond and Triple Strip borders and can be used both indoors and outdoors for a seamless finish.

When using these tiles outdoors, BAL Absolute Grouts MUST be used and a solid bed is required.

These tiles are suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement-based tile adhesive and grouts are used. Before fitting our Victorian Flooring™ range, please read our Planning and Preparation guide on our knowledge base or contact your local store.

Need a little more inspiration? Check out our Victorian Flooring style guide.

meta.description: Fila Instant Grout Remover
meta.title: Fila Instant Grout Remover | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Used to remove un-cured cementitious grout residue from tiles, the Fila Instant Grout Remover eliminates the need to continuously wash the tiles with water, reducing the risk of efflorescence and grout discolouration, caused by over-washing.

Reducing the amount of time cleaning, this innovative fast acting, rapid dry formula can be used inside and out and on porcelain and ceramic tiles that don’t have a crackle glaze. If your grout has already cured, then you will need to use Fila’s Porcelain Cement Residue Remover to remove leftover grout haze from the tiles.

result.name: Hemsworth™ Grey Tile
result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tile Trims & Tile Edging

meta.title: Foundry™ Trims | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Providing a durable and decorative finish, this Foundry trim is comprised of solid brass to create a luxurious 2.5m edging strip in two easy to use profiles, a 10mm straight edge and the 12.5mm box.

The brass trim is handcrafted for an authentic vintage look, taking inspiration from historical architecture. Nature also plays a role with the process of oxidisation which, over time, creates an organic looking patina on the surface of the trim.

If desired, the application of Topps Tiles’ Foundry Beeswax can slow down the oxidisation process. Simply remove any existing layers of oxidisation using conventional polishing agents and a non-abrasive cloth and then apply a thin layer of the wax.

  • When placing the product, ensure it does not come into contact with the tile adhesive or grout. If contact is made, wipe down straight away using clean water and then dry with a lint-free cloth.
  • Avoid contact with trowels, steel wool and other metal items to prevent scrapes and scratches.
  • Brass profiles can be mitred if using for window frames, part-tiled walls, external corners, and surrounding splashbacks.
  • Ensure care is taken around cut edges of the trim to prevent injury during installation.
  • Do not use any cement stain removers or chemically active cleaning products when wiping down the product's surface.

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

result.tile_care:
In some cases polished porcelain will have a transit wax on the tile surface to prevent scratching during transportation. This transit will need to be removed using Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover before grouting.
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Matrix® Diamond White Gloss Tile (14.8cm x 14.8cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Matrix® Diamond White Gloss Tile (14.8cm x 14.8cm)

media.alt_text: Matrix® Diamond White Gloss Tile fitted on shower wall.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Achieve professional, consistent results on every flooring job with the Roberts 4 in 1 Flooring Expansion Spacers. Designed to simplify the installation of vinyl, laminate, and engineered wood, these patented spacers provide the precise gaps needed for floors to expand and contract naturally.

What sets these apart is their unique self-bracing, 4-sided design. Unlike traditional wedges that can slip or tip over, these spacers remain perfectly upright and secure against the wall. This ensures your expansion gaps stay uniform from the first plank to the last, preventing future floor buckling or warping. With four specific measurements in one tool, they are the versatile solution for perimeter gaps and room-to-room transitions.

  • 4-in-1 Versatility: A single tool provides four essential measurements: 6.3mm, 9.5mm, and 12mm for perimeter walls, plus a 25mm spacing for thresholds and door transitions.
  • Anti-Tip Self-Bracing Design: The wide, stable base keeps each spacer upright during the installation process, eliminating the frustration of spacers falling over when the floor moves.
  • Prevents Floor Buckling: Ensures the precise expansion gap required for wood and laminate to breathe, protecting the installation against seasonal temperature and humidity changes.
  • Multi-Flooring Use: Perfect for installing luxury vinyl tile (LVT), laminate, and engineered wood flooring.
  • Durable & Reusable: Manufactured from high-impact plastic, these spacers are built for the rigours of trade use and can be reused across multiple projects.
  • Bulk Pack for Large Rooms: Supplied in a pack of 30, providing ample coverage for standard residential and commercial room sizes.

result.name: Kelsey™ Light Grey
result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

media.alt_text: Principle rectangular green tile fitted on bathroom wall with white bathtub.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Inspired by bold Victorian-esque colours and luxurious bespoke tiles, the Principle tile range marries beautiful classic colours with a modern take on environmental principles.

The tile is made up of over 91% recycled materials, composed of unfired tableware/stoneware residue, tile dust from regular tile production, vitrified ceramic stoneware and recycled glass drink bottles. These unique tiles divert a massive 8KG from landfill for every m2 produced and are locally sourced by the manufacturer in Spain, requiring a 23% reduction in gas during production*, contributing to an overall reduction in energy consumption.

You can tile with pride, helping to improve the planet without sacrificing on style.

*Calculations are based on a comparison with a like for like tile made using typical non-recycled material.

Please note that due to the unique glaze of our Green Principle tile all cleaning should be carried out using a pH neutral cleaner. We do not recommend the use of highly acidic or alkaline cleaners on these tiles.

Winner of the Wall Tile of the Year 2024 at the TTA awards.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Due to the glaze of this tile, BAL Protective Sealer must be used prior to grouting to prevent staining, especially when darker grouts are used.

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Born from experimenting with how light reacts on different glaze applications, the completely unique Spectre range features an innovative holographic surface finish. This revolutionary technology recreates the light spectrum through a glazing of precious metals, the same process that the automotive industry use to create a stunning iridescent finish.

Inside each mixed box there is 24% hologram, 38% matt and 38% gloss finishes meaning you can create a mixed design to really capture the light-reflecting properties of the range. Each piece features different gradients that create a variation of milky, pastel tones which can beautifully alter in appearance based on the changing light and the angle from which it’s viewed.

To get the full effect, avoid laying two holographic tiles close together and instead mix them between the matt and glossy finishes. This will ensure the tiles catch the light effectively, creating a calm serenity in any interior.

To ensure this beautiful and unique holographic finish is properly maintained, avoid using harsh acids or abrasive sponges when cleaning your tiles.

Box consists of 6 holographic, 9 matt & 9 gloss tiles.

If you would like to see a sample of this tile, please contact your local store.

Recycled Content: 73%

result.description:
Ayce is one of the purest white porcelain tiles available at such incredible value. The tile’s flat gloss has been specially formulated to create a smooth yet high gloss surface, providing a luxurious finish without the price tag.

Its rectified edges mean it’s easy to lay with its consistent sizing and straight lines making it a great choice for an interesting laying pattern. After all, it was inspired by the beautiful black and white chequered floor found at the Ace Hotel, in downtown Los Angeles, with its nod to the glamorous Art Deco era.

Due to the glaze of this tile, BAL Protective Sealer must be used prior to grouting to prevent staining, especially when darker grouts are used.

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

result.name: Apuano™ Tile (60cm x 60cm)
result.tile_care:
In some cases polished porcelain will have a transit wax on the tile surface to prevent scratching during transportation. This transit will need to be removed using Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover before grouting.
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Blue veined marble is a rare but beautiful natural stone that’s found between Apuan and the Apennine Alps in northern Italy. Based on several pieces of the real stone, we’ve expertly recreated this beauty on a porcelain base making it a fraction of the price of the real marble with the added benefit of a more practical finish.

To best show off the beautiful blue veins, the tile’s unique surface glaze is a matt opaque satin. To achieve these low-reflective satin textures, the oxide Zirconia, found in the earth’s minerals (providing stability in high temperatures, strong thermal and corrosion resistance and chemical inertness) has been enhanced. It avoids the high shine typically seen with marble tiles that limit their practical uses in the home. The high technical performance of this smooth, skin like texture means it can be used on a multitude of surfaces.

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

Ultra Level It Fast Track Plus is a beige coloured single part, flexible, high strength, rapid drying, protein free floor levelling compound which is formulated from a unique blend of graded fillers, fine cement and fibres which maximises the specifications of the product. When mixed with clean water it is free flowing across all surfaces from solid to timber floors. It is compatible with underfloor heating and can be finished off to a smooth underlayment surface.

Ideal for levelling floors from 2mm to 15mm deep the 20kg bag will cover 5m² at 3mm, 3.1m² at 5mm, 1.5m² at 10mm and 1m² at 15mm.

Ultra Level It Fast Track Plus has a 20 year guarantee.

Please note this product is not to be used when levelling over Warmup DCM Pro, this is due to the tensile strength of the levelling compound, when curing it will pull the matting up and away from the substrate. We only recommend Ultra Level It Two for use over the Warmup DCM Pro matting.

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Enis™ Ivory Slate Outdoor Tile (45cm x 90cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see the grout manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue
This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and wash using a cloth or large brush and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.
Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see the grout manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue
This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and wash using a cloth or large brush and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.
Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see the grout manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue
This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and wash using a cloth or large brush and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.
Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Prefer a sleek, almost invisible thermostat? Then the 6IE Mini, with its compact size and minimalist screen design, is for you. Built on the same Wi-Fi platform as the 6IE, the 6IE Mini works in conjunction with the Warmup MyHeating™ app to provide easy to use and efficient heating control.

It’s up to date chipset helps improve overall performance and reduces the Wi-Fi load. It also allows the smart programmable thermostat to connect with smart home hubs such as Amazon Alexa, Google Nest, and Apple Homepod, giving you ultimate operational convenience inside and outside of the home from your smart phone.

The Warmup 6IE Mini thermostat is exclusive to Topps Tiles.

To maintain the guarantee of the matt and loose wire we recommend purchasing the underfloor heating thermostat together with a full system from the same range.

For more information and installation advice please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

result.name: Emberton™ Dark Grey Tile (60cm x 60cm)
result.tile_care:
In some cases polished porcelain will have a transit wax on the tile surface to prevent scratching during transportation. This transit will need to be removed using Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover before grouting.
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth (covers 40m²). Leave to sit on the tile for 5 minutes. Work the residue off with a soft white emulsifying pad or cloth. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits and ensure the life span of the protection, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:200 capfuls clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Regal® Vanilla Movement Joint 12.5mm

meta.description: Regal Vanilla Movement Joint 12.5mm
meta.title: Regal Vanilla Movement Joint 12.5mm | Topps Tiles

result.description:
• 10mm width and various depths hard wearing aluminium movement joint matched to the Regal Collection range of tiles and grout.
  • These aluminium profiles absorb heavy stresses and evenly distribute them throughout the flooring and foundations. 
  • The epoxy-compound infill absorbs up to 20% across the width of the joint, e.g. 2mm is absorbed across a 10mm wide infill. 
  • The metal profile makes them ideal for heavy footfall areas.
  • When using them on floors where there is a joint in the sub-floor or a structural movement joint, they MUST be followed through into the tiled surface. 
  • They can also be used on suspended floors, directly over the junction of two substrates (e.g. screed to timber) or where the tiling area exceeds 10x10m (with no one side exceeding 10m in length).
  • On heated floors, they should be used where the tiling area exceeds 40m², with no side exceeding 8m in length. 
  • Select the profile to suit the thickness of the tiles being used.
  • During installation, apply the tile adhesive around the junction using a trowel, then press the profile into the adhesive and align it to the tiles.
  • Spread tile adhesive over the entire surface of the joint and fit the tiles into the adhesive, aligning them so they are flush with the top edge of the profile.
  • Allow a joint of 2mm around the profile and fill it with grout. 
  • Length: 2.5m.
  • Other depths are available.
